# Control plane capability inventory

<!-- generated by `quantick-app --dump-capability-inventory`; do not edit -->

Every capability the running application registers, as the registry
reports it. This file is generated; a hand edit is a guard failure, not
a correction. To change a row, change the capability and regenerate:

```sh
cargo run -p quantick-app -- --dump-capability-inventory \
  > docs/control-plane/capability-inventory.md
```

`cargo test -p quantick-guards` fails when this file and the registry
disagree, which is why it can be trusted where the prose it replaced
could not. See [Precedence](README.md#precedence) for which of the two
wins when they do disagree — the answer is never this file.

**Version** is the number an invocation must ask for; a capability may
register more than one. **Permissions** are the scopes a connection has
to hold, all of them, before the call is admitted; a capability with no
scope listed is reachable by any connected client. **Read-only** marks a
capability that cannot change application state.
